description: A player-owned activation with optional State cost, cooldown, and projectile.

cooldown.description: Optional countdown started only when admission succeeds.

cost.description: Optional cost charged only when admission succeeds.

id.description: Ability identity used by typed control operations.

projectile.description: Optional flight and hit behavior, using this ability's lifetime.

start.description: Player callback after the canonical activation commits.

ticks.description: Maximum loaded duration of an admitted instance.

when.description: Optional score that must equal one before admission.
